sources.label: Official Patagonia UK Kids' Size Chart (loaded from size-kids-unisex-data)

notes: US outdoor brand with an excellent kids' range and a lifetime guarantee. Kids' clothing is sized XS–XXL with an age guide (XS = 5–6, S = 7–8, M = 10, L = 12, XL = 14, XXL = 16–18). Legendary durability means Patagonia kids' items hold high value second-hand.
audit: Old stored URL (size-charts.html) is gone; the old rows (2T–14 numeric with UK/EU/height ranges) match no official Patagonia chart. Official Kids' Size Chart is XS–XXL with age, one height, chest, waist and hip (cm). e.g. old '10' chest 70 → M (10) 72, waist 61 → 65; old '14' chest 82 → XL (14) 80. Infant/toddler sizes (NB–5T) have only weight and length, so 2T–4T rows were removed rather than kept unverified. UK/EU/US removed (not published).
